segments.he: אֱלוּל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וְאִם לֹא תֹאבֶה הָאִשָּׁה לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֶיךָ. [ליקו"מ ח"ב פ"ז]
segments.en:
What was, is, and always shall be — that is Moshe. [Cross-reference: Moshe cluster below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 58:2; II:79

 מה ש"ע — מעשה
 
 Tziroof

 Mah + 370 (מה ש"ע) — the letters of מ"ה (45) together with the 370 lights = the letters of מעשה (maaseh, "deed"). Action (maaseh) is the unification of the Name Mah (45) with the 370 lights.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:7; 13

 מה'ק'ם' מלכין — שם קמ"ה
 
 Notarikon

 The letters מ, ק, ם from the phrase מהקם מלכין ("who sets up kings" [Daniel 2:21]) embody the Divine Name קמ"ה (= 145).

segments.he: אַלְמָן רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר. [חיי"מ סימן תס"ט]
אַלְמָן רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה. [ספר המידות אלמן, ב.]
segments.en:
168 = the number of letters in this Psalm.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:2; 6; marginal gloss to 19

 מ'חלוקת ש'מאי ה'לל — משה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the dispute between Shammai and Hillel" (מ׳חלוקת ש׳מאי ה׳לל) spell משה (Moshe). The great debates of the Talmud are the continuation of Moshe's Torah. [Cross-reference: Moshe cluster below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 56:8

 מחקק
 
 Gematria

 Mechokek (מחקק, "lawgiver / engraver" = 248) = gematria of Avraham (248) [cross-reference from Section 1]. The lawgiver and Avraham are numerically one — Avraham is the first lawgiver.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:26; 72; Sefer HaMidos "Drunkenness" 3, 4

 מחשבה — חשוב מה
 
 Tziroof

 Machshavah (מחשבה, "thought") — its letters contain חשוב מה (chashov mah, "reckon what [is above you]").

segments.he: אֱמוּנָה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא בָּנִים. [שיחות הר"ן ל"ד]
segments.en:
True thought is the reckoning of that which transcends — a reminder always to consider what is above. [Cross-reference from Section 8.]
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:82

 מ'ט"ט ש'ר ה'פנים — משה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "Metatron, Prince of the Face" (מ׳ט"ט ש׳ר ה׳פנים) spell משה (Moshe). Moshe is the human embodiment of Metatron, the angel of the divine face.

segments.he: אֶחָד רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת דִּבְרֵי אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. [השמטה משיחות הר"ן]
segments.en:
[Cross-reference: Moshe cluster below.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 13:3

 מטר
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Matar (מטר, "rain") — first letters of מ׳ראה ט׳עם ר׳יח: "sight, taste, smell" — the three most elevated senses through which divine pleasure is received. Rain feeds all three.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 12

 מי — חמישים
 
 Gematria

 Mi (מי, "who? / water" = 50) = gematria of chamishim (חמישים, "fifty"). "Who?" and fifty are the same — the highest level of questioning and the number of Jubilee/liberation are one.

segments.he: אֲדָר רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת. [שם]
segments.en:
[Cross-reference from Section 8.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 45

 מידד — מֵי דַד
 
 Notarikon

 Meidad (מידד — one of the two elders who prophesied in the camp [Numbers 11:26]) is read as מֵי דַד — "waters of the breast [nourishment]." The prophet draws from the nourishing waters of wisdom. [Compare Eldad = El Dad, "G-d of the breast," in Section 1.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 97

 מיכל
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Michal (מיכל) — first letters of כ׳י מ׳לאכיו י׳צוה ל׳ך: "For He will command His angels for you".

segments.he: אָדָם רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת דֶּרֶךְ מִצְוֹתֶיךָ אָרוּץ. [שיחות הר"ן קט"ז]
segments.en:
[Cross-reference from Section 11.]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §456

 מלאפום
 
 Notarikon

 Malapoum (מלאפום — the vowel cholam when written as a Vov) = מלא פום (mala pum, Aramaic: "fills the mouth") — the vowel that fills and rounds the mouth with its sound. It corresponds to the Yud-Vov letter-pair [cross-reference from Section 10].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 8:9; 34:5

 מלאך
 
 Multiple

 Malach (מלאך, "angel") yields three connections:

 (1) Tziroof Its letters are a permutation of כְּלָאֵם (kela'am, "He restrained them") [cross-reference f

segments.he: אֱמוּנָה רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת נִפְתְּחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וָאֶרְאֶה מַרְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים. [ליקו"ה חושן משפט בהקדמה]
segments.en:
rom Section 11];

 (2) Gematria Malach = gematria of סוכה (sukkah, "the festival booth" = 91);

 (3) Roshay Saveivos First letters of כ׳י א׳ין מ׳חסור ל׳יראיו and of כ׳י ל׳אלקים מ׳גיני א׳רץ [cross-references from Section 11].
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 7; II:5; 14

 מלבוש — בשלום / חשמל
 
 Tziroof

 Malbush (מלבוש, "garment") — its letters are a permutation of בשלום (beshalom, "in peace") [cross-reference from Section 2] and = gematria of חשמל (chashmal) [cross-reference from Section 8].
 
 Likutay Mooharan 35:6; 41

 מלוה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Milveh (מלוה, "a loan") — first letters of ו׳צבא ה׳שמים ל׳ך מ׳שתחוים. [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 13

 מם סתומה — שני דלתין
 
 Shape / Form

 The closed Mem (מם סתומה — the final form ם) has the shape of two Dalets joined together.

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וְאַתָּה הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ. [שם]
segments.en:
[Cross-reference from Section 4.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 135

 ממון
 
 Gematria

 Mamon (ממון, "money / wealth") — together with its letters = gematria of 140 voices (ק"מ קלין) [the 140 sounds associated with the giving of Torah].

 Roshay Saveivos

 Mamon — first letters of מ׳שם נ׳תעשר מ׳שה: "from there Moshe became wealthy" [referring to the sapphire chips that fell from the Tablets — Moshe kept them and became wealthy].

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת הָאָדָם וְהַחַי יִתֵּן אֶל לִבּוֹ. [שם]
segments.en:
The Vov in Mamon corresponds to the Tablets — whose length was 6 and whose width was 6.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 23:1; 60:1

 מן
 
 Notarikon

 Man (מן, "manna") = מ׳קוה של שער נ׳ון — "the reservoir of the Nun-gate" [a kabbalistic term for the 50th Gate of Understanding].

 Roshay Saveivos

 Man — first letters of מ׳אמר נ׳אמן: "a faithful utterance." The manna that fell from heaven was a faithful utterance made edible.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan 56:7

 מנצפ"ך — ורידין / ריו דין
 
 Gematria

 The five final letters (מנצפ"ך) = gematria of ורידין ("veins") and = gematria of ריו דין (216 + judgment).

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת וֶאֱמֶת יְיָ לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ. [שם]
segments.en:
[Cross-references from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 37:6

 מ"ס — מאה
 
 Gematria

 Mem-Samech (מ"ס = 100) = gematria of one hundred (מאה). [Cross-reference from Me'ah above.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 7:5

 מִסְפָּר — מִסֵּפֶר
 
 Notarikon

 Mispar (מִסְפָּר, "number") is read as misefer (מִסֵּפֶר, "from a book") — numbers come from the book. Counting is reading; quantity is text.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:30

 מעות — ו'אין ע'בירה מ'כבה ת'ורה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Ma'os (מעות, "coins / money") — first letters of ו׳אין ע׳בירה מ׳כבה ת׳ורה: "no sin extinguishes Torah." [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 204; Sichos HaRan 136

 מעט
 
 Gematria

 Me'at (מעט, "a little / few" = 119) = gematria of 119.

segments.he: אֵלִיָּהוּ רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת הֹלֵךְ יְיָ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּמְאַסִּפְכֶם אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל. [ליקו"ה הלכות שתפין, כז]
segments.en:
[The source connects this to a specific teaching in Chayay Mooharan §556 about the significance of smallness and "a little."]
 
 Chayay Mooharan §556

 מעקל — עמלק
 
 Tziroof

 Ma'kel (מעקל, "crooked / winding path") — its letters are a permutation of עמלק (Amalek). The crooked path is Amalek — the force that seeks to bend and distort the straight way.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:5; 11

 מערב
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Ma'arav (מערב, "west / evening") — first letters of ר׳חל מ׳בכה ע׳ל ב׳ניה: "Rachel weeping for her children" [Jeremiah 31:14]. The west — where the sun descends — encodes Rachel's weeping, for she weeps as light fades into exile.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:67

 מ'מצרים ו'לא י'ראו פ'ני ר'יקם
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "from Egypt and they shall not see My face empty-handed" (מ׳מצרים ו׳לא י׳ראו פ׳ני ר׳יקם) spell פורים (Purim). The redemption from Egypt carries within its first letters the festival of hidden redemption.

segments.he: אַבְרָהָם סוֹפֵי תֵבוֹת לֵב נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה. [שם]
segments.en:
[Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:74

 מצחק
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Metzachek (מצחק, "one who laughs / plays") — first letters of ח׳זה צ׳יון ק׳רית מ׳ועדנו: "See Zion, the city of our appointed times." [Cross-reference from Section 8.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan (end of story of the humble king)

 מצר — צמר
 
 Tziroof

 Metzar (מצר, "distress / narrow strait") — its letters are a permutation of צמר (tzemer, "wool"). The narrow straits of suffering contain within them the warmth and softness of wool — comfort is hidden within distress.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 29:10

 מצרימה' את' יעקב' איש' וביתו'
 
 Sofay Saveivos

 The final letters of "to Egypt, Yaakov, each man and his household" (מצרימה את יעקב איש וביתו) [Exodus 1:1] spell תשובה (teshuvah, "repentance / return").

segments.he: אֱלוּל רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת אִישׁ לְרֵעֵהוּ וּמַתָּנוֹת לָאֶבְיֹנִים. [ליקו"ה אפוטרופוס ב, יא.]
segments.en:
The very verse describing the descent into Egypt — the beginning of exile — contains in its final letters the word for return. Exile carries within it the seed of return.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:73

 מצת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Matzas (מצת, "[he] sucked / drew out") — first letters of צ׳דקה ת׳ציל מ׳מות: "charity saves from death" [Proverbs 10:2]. Drawing forth life through charity saves from death.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 201

 מקל — ואו
 
 Shape / Form

 Makel (מקל, "staff") has the shape of the letter Vov (ואו). [Cross-reference from Section 6.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 1

 מִקֵּץ — קָמַץ
 
 Tziroof

 Mikeitz (מִקֵּץ, "at the end of" [Genesis 41:1 — Yosef's dream interpretation after two years]) — its letters are a permutation of קָמַץ (kamatz — the vowel-sign below the letter, the broadest and most open vowel).
